'''Satele Shan Boulevard''' was a street on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was situated within [[Pyochayarit]], in the [[Azda Cluster]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the publishing company [[Anooba Press]] operated from [[Suite 44800]] of the property [[830-303 Satele Shan Boulevard]] located on the street.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Satele Shan]] Boulevard was first mentioned in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a reference book published in [[2013]]. The text was published from an in-universe perspective and Satele Shan Boulevard was mentioned within the address of the in-universe publisher of the ''Making a Killing'' supplement that accompanied the book.
